about.title: Automotive Expertise, Built Around Your Needs
about.intro: SebaTech is a Georgia-based team of passionate automotive specialists supplying dependable components and providing hands-on technical support to customers across multiple international markets.
about.reachTitle: Growing from Georgia to the world
about.storyTitle: More than an automotive parts supplier
about.storyParagraphOne: Our work covers a broad range of automotive components, from steering wheels and lighting systems to control units, engine and transmission parts, retrofit adapters, and suspension components. We combine product knowledge with a genuine enthusiasm for cars, helping each customer identify a solution that fits the vehicle and the job.
about.storyParagraphTwo: SebaTech has earned the trust of customers in Georgia, throughout the Caucasus, the Russian Federation, and the UAE. As we prepare to establish a presence in the United States, our goal remains unchanged: provide reliable parts, responsive communication, and expert assistance from initial selection through customization, coding, and programming support.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do you offer original parts or aftermarket?
faq.a1: We offer both! We clearly label whether a part is original (OEM) or a high-quality aftermarket alternative, so you can choose what best fits your budget and needs.
faq.a2: Orders placed before 2 PM are typically shipped the same day. Standard delivery within Tbilisi takes 1-2 business days, and regional delivery takes 2-4 business days.
faq.a3: We accept returns within 14 days of purchase, provided the part is unused and in its original packaging. Electrical parts cannot be returned once installed.
faq.q4: Do you help with part installation?
faq.a4: While we are primarily a parts supplier, we have partnered with several top-rated service centers across the country and can recommend a trusted mechanic for installation.
